content.json:
# Honeypot Dashboard — HR-FILE-SRV-01
Failed RDP logons (4625) from the internet: where they come from and which usernames bots try.

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "Failed logons"
| union (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1") | where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ",")) | summarize Value = dcount(IpAddress) | extend Metric = "Unique IPs")
| union (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1") | where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ",")) | summarize Value = dcount(TargetUserName) | extend Metric = "Unique usernames")
| union (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1") | where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ",")) | extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress).country) | summarize Value = dcount(Country) | extend Metric = "Countries")
content.title: Totals

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| summarize FailedAttempts = count() by IpAddress
| extend geo = geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress)
| extend Country = tostring(geo.country), City = tostring(geo.city), latitude = toreal(geo.latitude), longitude = toreal(geo.longitude)
| where isnotnull(latitude)
| project IpAddress, Country, City, latitude, longitude, FailedAttempts
content.title: Attack origins

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress).country)
| summarize Attempts = count() by Country
| top 10 by Attempts
content.title: Top countries

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| summarize Attempts = count() by User = tolower(TargetUserName)
| top 15 by Attempts
content.title: Most targeted usernames

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| summarize Attempts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Failed logons over time

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where IpAddress !in (split("{ExcludeIPs}", ","))
| summarize Attempts = count(), Accounts = dcount(TargetUserName), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by IpAddress
| extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress).country)
| top 25 by Attempts
content.title: Top attacker IPs

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType in (3, 10)
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| where not(coalesce(ipv4_is_private(IpAddress), false))
| project TimeGenerated, TargetUserName, IpAddress, LogonType, Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress).country)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Successful network/RDP logons from public IPs (should be only you and your classmate)
